device_scope: One previously paired Meizu Note 16 / Android 15
actor: Muse actual cloud environment using CLI.8 and the original approved persistent pairing

prior_failure.observed: Retained phone diagnostics show repeated connection timeouts and 30-second handshake deadlines while the service remained alive, the screen interactive and Doze false. The beginning of the original outage is not in the retained window.
prior_failure.network_path: Airtap was excluded from the existing VPN and used the underlying Wi-Fi network.
prior_failure.diagnosis_limit: The failing DNS/TCP/TLS/WebSocket phase and original outage trigger were not identified.

maintainer_intervention.action: Used the existing VPN app UI to remove Airtap from excluded applications and restart that VPN.
maintainer_intervention.unchanged: Airtap version, original pairing and other saved VPN rules were retained; the Airtap process was not replaced.
maintainer_intervention.claim_limit: A successful new connection followed a maintainer route change; this is not autonomous repair of the original direct path. VPN participation alone does not establish the final upstream exit selected by its rules.

short_regression.wait_ready: Not invoked: the first status was already connected.
short_regression.result: Muse observed the foreground, returned to the launcher and verified it; first and final status were approved, persistent, connected and pending 0.

evidence.independent_review_limit: This review checked the returned Muse summary and local phone diagnostic records. Underlying cloud command receipts and screenshots were retained privately and were not independently fetched in this review.

not_verified: Repair or stable reachability of the original direct Wi-Fi path
A specific DNS/TCP/TLS cause or final proxy exit
Autonomous wake or unattended long-idle recovery
Current-version Instinct, other devices or independent first use
publication_boundary: No accounts, network addresses, VPN subscription or selected node, connection IDs, exact device UID/PID, screenshots or private paths included.
